scope: Proposition 2.5 (Coherent path rotation) of the manuscript “Ramanujan-Arthur Decompositions of Cuspidal Functions at Full Finite Level” (preprints/Ramanujan-Arthur-Decompositions-of-Cuspidal-Functions-at-Full-Finite-Level-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b4b0cfe23007d159), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 13. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The preceding construction is an exact enhanced Frobenius-twisted cyclic functor. Put Φ = Fr∗ on local kernels. With convolution ordered in the direction of the path, its cyclic maps are ρU,V : K(U ⋆ V ) ∼ − → K(Φ(V ) ⋆ U). (2.2) They are natural in all enhanced morphisms and coherently compatible with units, iterated products, and change of level. Here ρU,1 is the identity. The full slide ρ1,V : K(V ) → K(ΦV ), followed by the Weil structure of V , is cohomological Frobenius. Slides at disjoint sets of legs commute; their product is the full slide.
